finding:

serves a parked page. Every install command and every docs link fails. In a JavaScript project, `init` stops at "bun
lock resolution failed" and leaves a `gspot.toml` behind, which then blocks a second `init`.

verification.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/init/write.ts:87-101 prepares both locks in a scratch folder before gspot.toml is written; `npm view @gspothq/cli` is E404; https://gspot.dev answers with a GoDaddy parked page; no git tag or GitHub release

Ship no binary. The owner decided on October 6, 2026 that gspot ships only as JavaScript on npm (review/owner-decisions/001). Non-JavaScript stacks still need the remaining work without a binary.
No GitHub environments are needed (review/owner-decisions/006). Publishing needs the two Cloudflare repository secrets and npm trusted publishing for the two packages.
